final-latent.scope: One already-selected valid tensor region; not suite or profile verification

final-rgba.scope: One already-selected valid tensor region; not suite or profile verification

scope.timing: One separate cached-cold process per mode; not warm or percentile acceptance. Cache entry presence does not prove a runtime cache hit.
scope.weight_scenario: Full source parameter tensors used by the wrapper, FP32 bytes, declared live from load start through release end. Compiler pruning/folding/constant duplication and actual resident weight pages are not measured.
scope.boundary_scenario: One contiguous backing per physical input/output contract during each call. Internal activations, retained host tensors and host/device copies or aliases are not modeled.
scope.unknown: Every category remains incomplete. planning_peak_bytes is null; known_live_peak_bytes is only the declared scenario contribution, not a RAM prediction or lower bound.
scope.difference: Observed point maximum minus source parameter payload is arithmetic across different accounting scopes, not unexplained workspace. Negative values are meaningful and retained. Kernel peak is cumulative over the process lifetime.
scope.quality: Final FP32 trace-to-source comparison for one input only; no human image quality or mobile acceptance.
